prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
System: Alder Creek Electrical Distribution Substation; layers separated, loss never silently substituted. Elements: Bay Automation Controller (Juniper): executes only approved-logic/interlock-permitted commands; validates requests; flags incomplete/contradictory ops; stale→degraded; receives Breaker Inspection Tag, Battery Load Test Record; sends Bay Status Digest to Glasswing. North/South Bay Controllers: separate scopes; block unready close; North keeps local control if supervisory comms lost; South reports local mode. Breaker Control Unit: authoritative interlocks; rejects commands failing permissives; returns position/health; no bypass. Feeder Protection Relay (Tandem): protection independent of supervisory comms; Relay Diagnostic Note to Larkspur. North Protection Panel; Transformer Protection Panel. Station Supervisory Control System (Glasswing): presents indications/command results, quality/stale; retains alarms; produces Alarm Acknowledgement Slip; receives Protocol Retry Summary. Station Gateway: maintains automation/external boundary; rejects/logs bad requests; produces Protocol Retry Summary. Satellite Time Receiver (Bluefin): Clock Drift Snapshot to Orchard; holdover; time-quality issues investigated before sequence analysis. Sequence Event Archive (Orchard): authoritative time-ordered events for reconstruction. Engineering Workstation: authorized config under change control; Settings Review Receipt to Maintenance Remote Terminal. Station DC System: confirmed available before control-power-dependent switching; produces Battery Load Test Record. Actors: Control Room Operator: decides automation appropriateness; commands via Glasswing; local confirmation when remote incomplete/inconsistent/delayed; tracks out-of-service protection; produces Clearance Handoff Memo → Keystone. Switching Desk Coordinator (Keystone): produces Isolation Boundary Card; checks memo vs active switching record; confirms authority/state/comm limits before automation actions; handback. Protection Relay Engineer (Larkspur): reviews after material changes, records concerns; assesses unexplained trips before return to service. Substation Field Crew (Cinder): uses Isolation Boundary Card before entry; sends Breaker Inspection Tag; pauses if boundary uncertain; reports unexpected conditions. Substation Supervisor: escalation; change control; confirms records complete, restrictions cleared, risks owned before normal service. Requirements: faults assessed before restart/bypass/replacement; restoration confirms indications, protection, comms, test connections removed; remote commands inhibited if status uncertain; calibrated tests; hold points; unique revisions.

New part:
S240: The Maintenance Remote Terminal shall use controlled access, and each maintenance session shall be attributable to an authorized user.
S241: The North Bay Controller shall be checked for expected local behavior after approved configuration work.
S242: The South Bay Controller shall be checked for expected local behavior after approved configuration work.
S243: The North Protection Panel shall remain available for independent protection functions during supervisory control interruptions.
S244: The Transformer Protection Panel shall remain within its approved settings and operating constraints during handover.
S245: Periodic operational reviews shall examine command outcomes, event records, exceptions, and corrective actions so that automation decisions remain traceable and safe.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
